_comment: Digest pins for the formal Gateway build (Dockerfile.formal).
A tag is a mutable pointer: golang:1.25-bookworm names different bytes on
different days. Building a formal image from a tag would mean an identical
commit could produce a different binary, so 'same source' would not imply
'same image' and the revision label would bind nothing that matters.
Each entry pins one base image by its registry content digest. The formal
builder resolves the reference it is about to use through Docker Engine and
refuses to build when the resolved digest differs from the pin recorded
here, so an upstream retag fails the build instead of silently changing the
A digest of "" means the image is NOT yet pinned. The formal builder treats
an unpinned base as a hard failure rather than resolving the tag, because a
build that quietly accepts whatever the tag points at today is exactly the
provenance gap this file exists to close. Record the pins on a host with
which resolves each tag once, writes the digest here, and leaves the result
to be reviewed and committed like any other source change.
